goal.fresh_confirmation: Separate first-use Aegis test; source-specific healthy classifier evaluation, not the operational target.

development_only.original_source: Frozen synthetic train and threshold-validation roles only
development_only.label: human prompt_label; safe=0 and unsafe=1; no response labels or relabeling
exclude: Exact overlap with prior synthetic, ToxicChat, XSTest, or original prompt-pool records
development_only.split_policy: Preserve official splits; exact and lexical-near duplicate components stay together. Test takes precedence over validation, and validation over train.
development_only.near_duplicate_policy: Fixed normalized word 3-shingle Jaccard >=0.85, 32 deterministic MinHash signatures, eight bands of four; exact normalized duplicates always join. Lexical grouping is not proof of semantic independence.
development_only.test_boundary: Only a separate data-quality stage can inspect held-out identities and labels for duplicate/conflict checks. No held-out inference, metrics, or threshold selection before the model freeze.

fixed_candidates.description: Released TF-IDF weights; new validation-only threshold

fit.algorithm: Existing word/character TF-IDF and logistic regression C=4, max_iter=500, seed=42
fit.feature_fit: One vocabulary fit on the combined training text only
fit.sample_weights: Fixed source shares, equal total class weight within each source, equal group weight within each source/class
fit.canary: Frozen released canary and threshold; no fit

selection.threshold_objective: Maximize equal-source group-balanced accuracy under empirical per-source safe FPR <=0.05
candidate_ties: Earlier candidate in the fixed list
selection.failure_action: Preserve the released model; report all candidates and failed gates.

runtime.health_panel_note: The same quantile rule can select different panel rows when a new guardrail changes score order. No runtime rule is tuned.
runtime.evaluation: One selected candidate; all 60 episodes, both external regressions, independent numeric audit, and first-use Aegis test

execution.source: Exact committed archives in new private run directories
